import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot of amount vs hour_of_day, colored by is_fraud
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', 
                          palette={0: 'blue', 1: 'red'}, alpha=0.6)

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Credit Card Transactions: Amount vs Hour of Day', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Fraudulent', loc='upper left', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
